items.raw_excerpt: More tourism-related businesses have slammed the proposed 1,000-baht outbound tax, which could be raised to a maximum of 5,000 baht, saying it would have a huge impact on the fragile tourism industry and exacerbate the unfair value-added tax (VAT) burden on outbound tourism operators despite their costs being incurred outside Thailand.
items.summary_en: Travel businesses in Thailand spoke out against a proposed 1,000-baht tax on Thais travelling abroad. They said the tax could rise to 5,000 baht and would hurt the already fragile tourism industry. The travel agents also said outbound operators face unfair VAT costs even though those costs happen outside Thailand.
items.summary_ko: 태국 여행 관련 업체들이 태국인의 해외 여행에 부과하려는 1,000바트의 출국세 신설안에 반대 입장을 밝혔다. 이 세금은 최대 5,000바트까지 오를 수 있으며, 이미 취약한 관광 산업을 흔들 것이라고 업체들은 주장했다. 여행사들은 또한 해외 출국 관련 비용이 태국 밖에서 발생하는데도 출국여행 운영자들이 부당한 부가세 부담을 지고 있다고 지적했다.
